GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly, Eased & Settled Down 5 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide soon after, made no ground to 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, carried wider on turn then couldn't come on in Straight # very few excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Carried out round home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn , pocketed rounding turn, blocked behind runners Straightening Up (rider evidently decided against switching inside), clear running became available at 200m, baulked and hampered at 175m then only made limited ground to the line # Had a few excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Wanted to lay in under pressure in the straight. Near the 200m hampered and became unbalanced when bumped by GALWAY HUSSLER.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Drifted Back Settled Down Off Mid-Field Two Wide with cover 7 Lengths Ridden Along Turning for home Just Kept Going One Pace - # Just Held Ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 50m, raced in restricted room for a short distance.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 3.5 Lengths rail turning, Two Wide at 400m, around heels Straightening Up and ran on hitting Lead 30m from line # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Resaddled at gates. Had some difficulty obtaining clear running for a short distance near the 300m. Wanted to lay in under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Settled back 2nd last rails 6 Lengths 800m, stayed back inside and gaps opened Straightening Up , Made Good Ground last 200m to be Just out of placings # made ground rails
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported once obtaining clear ground in the straight, mount took some time to build before finishing off well.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Drifted Back 2nd last Two Wide 5 Lengths 700m, came widest from the corner, knuckled down last 200m and charged late for close second spot, Blinkers First Time # ran on hard
Jumped ok drifted back settling down second last 8 Lengths (800m), cornered about to come off fence & tryi to make Ground , Under Whip did So Without threat # ran on/fitter
Jumped Ok Restrained Straight Out The Back Settled Down rear Inside 8 Lengths held together same to turn clear run home couldn't quicken - # couldn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at the start. Hampered and carried in passing the 700m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Straight To The Front steadied Settled Down Run Of Race 4th Inside 2 Lengths locked away nowhere to go until the Straightening Up Kept Trying but had its chance - # had all favours

Jumped okay & Settled Down 6 Lengths on fence, railed to 4 Lengths turning, angled off fence 400m, shifted out Five Wide Straightening Up and ran on down the outside, hit Lead 150m and kept going to post # ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Lost the off-fore plate in the running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , took sit Two Wide With Cover behind speed 3 Lengths 800m, stayed back inside when Leader rolled off Straightening Up , burst Through last 200m and she won with ease # dominant late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out under pressure over the final 100m.
